verdict.rationale: CRA documents sanctioned third-party rails. Representatives use the Represent a Client portal to request online access to an account (cra-docs-18), and taxpayers can authorize access to their online information (cra-docs-10). Representatives can file returns or make payments for individual or business clients (cra-docs-11), and EFILE pairs CRA-certified software with enrolled electronic filers who transmit on clients' behalf (cra-docs-14, cra-docs-19, cra-supp-3). Missing for 10: detailed docs on how a business grants and scopes representative authorization (access levels, revocation), EFILE evidence that covers business rather than only individual T1 returns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
